name: ovgrid
description: OVGrid — Open Virtual Grid: an open, serverless P2P virtual world (WebGPU + GenosDB + Polygon) that showcases GenosDB powering the live state of a 3-D world.
author: Esteban Fuster Pozzi (@estebanrfp)

scripts.build: bun build ./mainPlanet.js --outdir=./dist --target browser --splitting --minify --sourcemap=external --public-path ./ && cp index.html styles.css dist/ && cp -r assets dist/ && bun scripts/prune-dist-assets.js && bun scripts/fix-imports.js && cp -r lib dist/
